title: Edmonton Emergency Help Points
summary: Emergency hospitals, urgent treatment centres, and hazard guidance for Edmonton (N9, N18).
content:
In life-threatening emergencies, always call 999 or 112 immediately. For urgent medical advice, call NHS 111. For power cuts, call 105. For gas leaks, call 0800 111 999.

1. 24-Hour Emergency Hospitals with A&E:
- North Middlesex University Hospital: Sterling Way, Edmonton, N18 1QX. From Silver Street station: ~6 min walk west along Sterling Way (A406 North Circular). From Edmonton Green station: ~18 min walk south along Fore Street (A1010) and Sterling Way, or bus 102, 144, 149, or 279.
- Royal London Hospital (Major Trauma Centre): Whitechapel Road, E1 1FR. From Edmonton Green: London Overground south to Liverpool Street / Whitechapel connection (~30 min), or ~7.5 miles south via A10.

2. Urgent Treatment Centres (UTC):
- North Middlesex Urgent Treatment Centre: co-located with North Middlesex Hospital A&E at Sterling Way, N18 1QX (open 24 hours). From Silver Street station: ~6 min walk west along Sterling Way.

3. Local Hazards & Flood Risks:
- High flood risk areas border the River Lea and Lee Navigation on the eastern flank (Edmonton Marshes). Pymmes Brook and Salmons Brook flow through Upper and Lower Edmonton, creating localized surface flooding near the North Circular and Angel Edmonton.

4. Essential Supplies:
Pharmacies, grocers, and supermarkets inside Edmonton Green Shopping Centre, Fore Street, and Hertford Road provide water, sanitary goods, and emergency provisions.

Note: addresses and opening hours may have changed — confirm on arrival where possible.
